roles.description: Company policy administrator. Defines purchasing policy and may grant scoped exceptions to overridable spending and supplier rules.
Procurement manager. May approve individual purchases and grant scoped spending-threshold exceptions up to PKR 500,000. Cannot override supplier rules.
Procurement staff who record catalogue and delivery facts. No authority to approve purchases or grant exceptions.
External supplier. Can send offers and information only. Has no authority over company policy, approvals or exceptions.
